reply_text:
I found one 2024 statement that meets all four tests. None of the three claims already on your list turned up in pages I could read, so none is reported again. The year doesn't count as quiet.

**The candidate: Davos, 16 January 2024.** Speaking with Klaus Schwab, Nadella said AI would spread to users far faster than cloud computing did. Cloud took "15 years or 10 years", and AI "may take five or even less", reaching the Global South too. I read this on the World Economic Forum's podcast page. The page says its transcript was made by speech-recognition software and may contain errors, so check the wording against the recording.

**Excluded, with reasons:**
- **Davos, same talk:** AI as "taking 250 years of chemistry and somehow bringing it down to 25 years". He used this to describe a battery-material result, not to predict a date.
- **Ignite keynote, 19 November 2024:** developer agents that "will just ship in the months to come". There's no date, and it isn't about when AGI arrives, so it fails test 3 and isn't listed as undated either.
- **Ignite, other forward-dated items:** a security chip in every new Azure server "starting next year", a virtual machine available "next year", and a Windows 365 Link device in "April of next year". All are chip or product plans, not AI forecasts.
- **Ignite, scaling remark:** "doubling every six months or so" describes what is happening now, not a prediction.

**Gaps you should know about:**
- **BG2 podcast, 12 December 2024 (Bill Gurley and Brad Gerstner):** the transcript cut off at about 34:40. That part has nothing dated. His only forward line there is undated, that shopping or travel agents may move commercial searches into chat ("one or two of these agents… away"). The widely reported "SaaS is dead" remarks come later in the episode, which I couldn't see. I didn't find a dated claim from them.
- **Build keynote PDF, 21 May 2024:** my own mistake lost it. The page opened, but I didn't save the text and it fell out of a cut-off printout, so I read none of it. That's why I couldn't confirm the two Build claims already on your list.
- **Page limit:** both of my last two page openings went to reopening the Ignite and Davos pages. With none left, I ran no further searches. I didn't open the Stratechery interview or the Davos All-In session.
